description: Zones whose standard offsets are known to differ from java.time. Each entry needs a reason.

zones.Africa/Windhoek: The JDK converts the vanguard negative DST of Namibia itself (standard offset +01:00 since 1990); rearguard.zi has 2:00 until 1994 and from 2017 on
zones.Europe/Dublin: The JDK converts the vanguard negative DST of Eire itself (standard offset Z in 1968-1971); rearguard.zi has 1:00, as ThreeTen-Backport's test_Dublin_getStandardOffset expects
